meta.source: 手作業で作成した文脈推測原稿

sentences: A dark blotch of ink spread across the corner of the manuscript.
Two words disappeared under it, and the paper remained stained after drying.
clues: the paper remained stained after drying
items.reason: その下で二語が読めなくなり、乾いた後も紙に跡が残ったと述べられています

items.sense: 閉鎖的な仲間内の集団
sentences: A tight clique of veterans controlled every committee in the club.
The same six names appeared on all the lists, and new members were never asked.
clues: The same six names appeared on all the lists
items.reason: どの名簿にも同じ六人が並び、新会員には声もかからなかったと述べられています

sentences: Winning the tournament marked the pinnacle of her long career.
She never played better afterwards and retired the following season.
items.reason: その後それ以上の出来はなく、翌季に引退したと述べられています

sentences: The government offered a bounty for every rat brought to the depot.
Villagers received twenty coins per animal, and the clerk paid in cash.
clues: Villagers received twenty coins per animal
items.reason: 一匹につき二十枚が村人に渡され、係員が現金で支払ったと述べられています

sentences: A visiting prelate presided over the ceremony in the cathedral.
He wore a tall mitre, and two hundred priests stood as he entered.
clues: two hundred priests stood as he entered
items.reason: 高い冠をかぶり、入場の際に司祭二百人が立ったと述べられています

sentences: The election became a farce once the opposition candidates withdrew.
Only one name remained on the ballot, and the count took four minutes.
clues: Only one name remained on the ballot
items.reason: 投票用紙に名が一つしか残らず、開票も四分で済んだと述べられています

sentences: The research center began as an offshoot of a small engineering department.
Three professors left that department in 1998 and set up their own laboratory.
clues: Three professors left that department in 1998
items.reason: 一九九八年に三人の教授がその学科を出て、自分たちの研究室を作ったと述べられています

sentences: The speech offered nothing but a platitude about hard work and patience.
Every listener had heard the same sentence at a dozen other ceremonies.
clues: Every listener had heard the same sentence
items.reason: 聞き手の誰もが、他の式典で十度も同じ文を聞いていたと述べられています

sentences: The caucus lasted four hours before a single nominee emerged.
Only party members could enter the room, and they argued until one name won.
clues: Only party members could enter the room
they argued until one name won
items.reason: 党員だけが入れる部屋で議論し、一つの名に絞られたと述べられています

sentences: The restored bridge stands as a testament to the engineers' patience.
It took nine years and eleven thousand replaced rivets to finish the work.
items.reason: 九年と一万一千本の鋲の交換を要した仕事だと述べられています

sentences: At this juncture, withdrawing the product would cost more than fixing it.
Two million units are already in shops, and the repair kit is ready.
clues: Two million units are already in shops
items.reason: すでに二百万台が店頭にあり、修理部品も用意できている状況だと述べられています

sentences: Long-standing enmity between the two villages faded after the flood.
They had not shared a road or a festival for sixty years before that summer.
clues: They had not shared a road or a festival
for sixty years before that summer
items.reason: その夏までの六十年、道も祭りも共にしていなかったと述べられています

sentences: New housing appeared on the periphery of the city throughout the decade.
Nothing was built in the center, and the new streets all lay beyond the ring road.
clues: Nothing was built in the center
the new streets all lay beyond the ring road
items.reason: 中心部には何も建たず、新しい通りはすべて環状道路の外側だったと述べられています

sentences: The bank agreed to a six-month deferral of the couple's mortgage payments.
They pay nothing until October, and the same amount resumes afterwards.
items.reason: 十月までは払わず、その後は同額の支払いが再開すると述べられています

sentences: Income from the endowment covers a third of the museum's running costs.
Donors gave the capital in 1954, and only the interest is ever spent.
clues: only the interest is ever spent
items.reason: 一九五四年に寄せられた元金で、使うのは利息だけだと述べられています

sentences: A commotion in the corridor interrupted the examination for several minutes.
Two people shouted, a chair fell over, and the invigilator ran outside.
clues: Two people shouted, a chair fell over
items.reason: 二人が叫び、椅子が倒れ、試験監督が外へ走り出たと述べられています

sentences: The library holds records useful for anyone tracing a local genealogy.
Birth and marriage registers go back to 1620 and name every parent.
clues: Birth and marriage registers go back to 1620
items.reason: 出生と婚姻の記録が一六二〇年まで遡り、親の名も記されていると述べられています

sentences: The breed has a propensity to bark at anything that moves.
Owners report the same behavior in nine dogs out of ten.
clues: in nine dogs out of ten
items.reason: 飼い主の報告では十匹のうち九匹に同じ振る舞いが見られると述べられています

sentences: As an extrovert, he found the months of remote work unexpectedly draining.
He had always gathered energy from crowded rooms and long conversations.
clues: He had always gathered energy from crowded rooms
items.reason: 人の多い部屋や長い会話から力を得てきた人だと述べられています

sentences: It is the union's contention that the safety rules were ignored.
Its lawyers repeat this in every hearing and have filed two written statements.
clues: Its lawyers repeat this in every hearing
items.reason: 組合側の弁護士が公聴会ごとに同じことを述べ、書面も二度出したと述べられています

sentences: The prison's reformation of its training program reduced repeat offenses.
Classes were rebuilt around real trades, and returns to custody fell by a quarter.
clues: Classes were rebuilt around real trades
returns to custody fell by a quarter
items.reason: 実際の職業に沿って講座を作り替え、再収容が四分の一減ったと述べられています

sentences: The magazine profiled a socialite who had funded three city galleries.
She appears at every opening night and knows most of the city's donors by name.
clues: She appears at every opening night
knows most of the city's donors by name
items.reason: 初日の催しに必ず姿を見せ、市内の寄付者の多くを名前で知っていると述べられています

sentences: The fugitive was recognized by a hotel clerk in a coastal town.
He had left the city after the verdict and used three different names.
clues: He had left the city after the verdict
items.reason: 判決後に市を離れ、三つの偽名を使っていたと述べられています

sentences: An untreated cavity can eventually damage the nerve inside a tooth.
The hole grows deeper each month until it reaches the soft center.
clues: The hole grows deeper each month
until it reaches the soft center
items.reason: 穴が月ごとに深くなり、やがて柔らかな中心に達すると述べられています

sentences: The drumming put several dancers into something close to a trance.
Their eyes stayed half closed, and they did not answer when spoken to.
clues: did not answer when spoken to
items.reason: 目を半ば閉じたままで、声をかけても答えなかったと述べられています

sentences: An upstart from outside the industry now sells more units than either giant.
The firm was founded four years ago in a rented garage.
clues: The firm was founded four years ago
items.reason: 四年前、借りた車庫で創業した会社だと述べられています

sentences: Engineers calculated the velocity of the falling weight from the video footage.
They divided the distance in each frame by the time between frames.
clues: They divided the distance in each frame
items.reason: 各コマの移動距離をコマ間の時間で割ったと述べられています

sentences: A single ember from the campfire started the blaze on the hillside.
It was carried by the wind, still glowing red, and landed in dry grass.
clues: It was carried by the wind, still glowing red
items.reason: 赤く光ったまま風に運ばれ、乾いた草の上に落ちたと述べられています

sentences: The borrower defaulted after the interest rate doubled within a year.
He missed six payments in a row, and the bank began to take the house.
clues: He missed six payments in a row
the bank began to take the house
items.reason: 六回続けて支払いを欠かし、銀行が家の差し押さえに動いたと述べられています

sentences: A new tram line revitalized the neglected district within three years.
Forty shops opened on a street where half the buildings had been empty.
clues: Forty shops opened on a street
where half the buildings had been empty
items.reason: 建物の半分が空だった通りに、四十の店が開いたと述べられています

sentences: He gargled with warm salt water twice a day for his sore throat.
He held the liquid at the back of his mouth, made a sound, and spat it out.
clues: He held the liquid at the back of his mouth
items.reason: 液を喉の奥に留めて音を立て、吐き出したと述べられています

sentences: Social media amplified a rumor that had begun in a single message.
One post became two hundred thousand within a day, and three papers repeated it.
clues: One post became two hundred thousand within a day
items.reason: 一つの投稿が一日で二十万に増え、新聞三紙も追随したと述べられています

sentences: The wind finally abated shortly before dawn on the third day.
The shutters stopped rattling, and the crew went out on deck again.
clues: the crew went out on deck again
items.reason: 雨戸の音が止まり、乗組員が再び甲板に出たと述べられています

sentences: The reform emancipated tenant farmers who had worked the land for generations.
They received title to their fields and owed no further labor to the landlord.
clues: They received title to their fields
owed no further labor to the landlord
items.reason: 耕していた田畑の権利を得て、地主への労役も負わなくなったと述べられています

sentences: The cheap lens distorted the edges of every photograph he took.
Straight walls curved outward, and faces at the side looked stretched.
clues: faces at the side looked stretched
items.reason: 直線の壁が外に反り、端の顔が引き伸ばされて見えたと述べられています

sentences: The contract delineated the duties of each party in careful detail.
Nine numbered clauses say who pays, who repairs, and who answers complaints.
clues: Nine numbered clauses say who pays
items.reason: 番号付きの九条が、支払う者、修理する者、苦情に答える者を定めていると述べられています

sentences: The family liquidated its remaining shares to pay the inheritance tax.
Everything was sold in three weeks, and the account held only cash afterwards.
clues: Everything was sold in three weeks
the account held only cash afterwards
items.reason: 三週間で全て売り、口座には現金だけが残ったと述べられています

sentences: The team floundered in the second half and lost its early advantage.
Passes went astray, two players collided, and nobody organized the defense.
clues: Passes went astray, two players collided
items.reason: パスが乱れ、選手二人が衝突し、守りを整える者もいなかったと述べられています

sentences: The injured fox whimpered quietly until the rescue team arrived.
The sound was thin and low, and it came from under the fallen branches.
clues: The sound was thin and low
it came from under the fallen branches
items.reason: 細く低い声が、倒れた枝の下から聞こえたと述べられています

sentences: The hens pecked at the grain scattered across the yard.
Their heads went down again and again, and the ground was clean in ten minutes.
clues: Their heads went down again and again
the ground was clean in ten minutes
items.reason: 頭を何度も下ろし、十分で地面がきれいになったと述べられています

sentences: The crew sanitized the aircraft cabin between every scheduled flight.
They wiped each tray and armrest with alcohol and changed the headrest covers.
clues: They wiped each tray and armrest with alcohol
items.reason: 卓と肘掛けを酒精で拭き、枕当ての布も取り替えたと述べられています

sentences: A week by the sea rejuvenated the exhausted researchers completely.
They returned sleeping well, and two of them wrote papers within a month.
clues: two of them wrote papers within a month
items.reason: よく眠れる状態で戻り、うち二人は一か月で論文を書いたと述べられています

sentences: Villagers bartered eggs and firewood when banknotes became worthless.
Nobody used money for a year, and each family kept a list of what it owed.
clues: Nobody used money for a year
each family kept a list of what it owed
items.reason: 一年間誰も貨幣を使わず、各家が貸し借りの覚えを書いていたと述べられています

sentences: She mustered enough courage to speak at the shareholders' meeting.
Her hands shook as she stood, and she had rehearsed the question for a week.
clues: Her hands shook as she stood
had rehearsed the question for a week
items.reason: 立ち上がる時は手が震え、一週間その問いを練習していたと述べられています

sentences: He cringed at the sound of his own recorded voice.
His shoulders pulled in, and he reached for the stop button at once.
clues: reached for the stop button at once
items.reason: 肩がすぼまり、すぐ停止の押しボタンに手を伸ばしたと述べられています

sentences: A handful of executives orchestrated the takeover over several quiet months.
They met in private, bought shares through three firms, and told no one until March.
items.reason: 密かに会い、三つの会社を通じて株を買い、三月まで誰にも告げなかったと述べられています

sentences: The general vanquished a much larger army on the frozen river.
The other side lost most of its cavalry and signed terms the next week.
clues: The other side lost most of its cavalry
items.reason: 相手は騎兵の大半を失い、翌週に条件を受け入れたと述べられています

sentences: Kidnappers abducted the diplomat's driver but released him unharmed.
They took him from a car park at night and left him at a station two days later.
clues: They took him from a car park at night
left him at a station two days later
items.reason: 夜に駐車場から連れ去り、二日後に駅へ置いていったと述べられています

sentences: Autumn leaves swirled around the courtyard whenever the gate opened.
They rose in a circle, turned twice, and settled again in the same corner.
clues: They rose in a circle, turned twice
settled again in the same corner
items.reason: 円を描いて舞い上がり、二度回って同じ隅に落ち着いたと述べられています

sentences: Officers who fraternized with residents of the occupied town faced disciplinary action.
Two were punished for drinking in local houses and lending their coats to children.
clues: punished for drinking in local houses
items.reason: 地元の家で酒を飲み、子どもに上着を貸したことで二人が処分されたと述べられています

sentences: The salesman beguiled the elderly couple into signing a costly contract.
He praised their garden for an hour and never mentioned the monthly fee.
clues: He praised their garden for an hour
items.reason: 一時間庭をほめ続け、毎月の費用には触れなかったと述べられています

sentences: The ferry's propellers churned the muddy water of the estuary.
Brown foam rose behind the boat and did not clear for several minutes.
clues: Brown foam rose behind the boat
did not clear for several minutes
items.reason: 船の後ろに茶色い泡が立ち、数分間消えなかったと述べられています

sentences: The blight impoverished farming communities across the entire province.
Two harvests failed, and families sold their tools to buy flour.
clues: families sold their tools to buy flour
items.reason: 二度の収穫が失われ、各家が粉を買うために道具を売ったと述べられています

sentences: He tilted the lamp so that the light fell on the map.
The shade now pointed downward at an angle instead of straight at the ceiling.
clues: The shade now pointed downward at an angle
instead of straight at the ceiling
items.reason: 笠が天井の方ではなく、斜め下を向くようになったと述べられています

sentences: Interest accrued on the unpaid balance at four percent annually.
The debt grew by itself each month even though he borrowed nothing more.
clues: The debt grew by itself each month
even though he borrowed nothing more
items.reason: 追加で借りていないのに、残高が月ごとに自ら増えたと述べられています

sentences: She ruminated on the offer for a week before turning it down.
She wrote the advantages on one page, the risks on another, and slept badly.
clues: She wrote the advantages on one page
items.reason: 利点と危険を別々の紙に書き出し、よく眠れなかったと述べられています

sentences: Rebuilding the stadium would carry an astronomical price for a small city.
The estimate equals nine years of the town's entire construction budget.
clues: of the town's entire construction budget
items.reason: 見積りが町の建設予算九年分に相当すると述べられています

sentences: The magazine published a satirical cartoon about the new parking rules.
It drew the mayor measuring a bicycle with a ruler while a lorry blocked the street.
clues: It drew the mayor measuring a bicycle with a ruler
while a lorry blocked the street
items.reason: 貨物車が道をふさぐ中、市長が自転車を定規で測る絵だと述べられています

sentences: Their acrimonious dispute over the boundary lasted eleven years.
Letters between them used insults, and neither family attended the other's funerals.
clues: neither family attended the other's funerals
items.reason: やりとりの手紙に罵りが混じり、互いの葬儀にも出なかったと述べられています

sentences: Regular inspection is imperative for equipment used at these depths.
One unchecked seal caused a flood that cost two lives in 1998.
clues: One unchecked seal caused a flood
items.reason: 一九九八年、点検されなかった封が浸水を招き二人の命が失われたと述べられています

sentences: Artists moved into a derelict warehouse near the old canal.
No company had used it for twenty years, and half the windows were gone.
clues: No company had used it for twenty years
items.reason: 二十年どの会社も使わず、窓の半分が失われていたと述べられています

sentences: The inspector gave the boiler a perfunctory glance and signed the form.
He stayed for ninety seconds and opened no panel at all.
items.reason: 滞在は九十秒で、点検口を一つも開けなかったと述べられています

sentences: A conciliatory letter from the principal calmed most of the parents.

clues: invited every family to a meeting
items.reason: 混乱を謝り、全家庭を会合に招いたと述べられています

sentences: Distrust of the census was pervasive in the northern districts.

clues: Nine villages out of ten refused the forms
items.reason: 役人が何を言っても、十の村のうち九が用紙を拒んだと述べられています

sentences: The venerable law firm has occupied the same building since 1878.

clues: Portraits of its founders line the stairs
items.reason: 階段に創業者の肖像が並び、顧客には古い銀行三行が含まれると述べられています

sentences: Investors must be fully cognizant of the risks before signing.
Each one initials a page listing every way the money could be lost.
clues: listing every way the money could be lost
items.reason: 資金を失いうる全ての事情を並べた紙に、一人ずつ署名すると述べられています

sentences: The mediator proposed an equitable division of the shared land.

clues: Each brother received the same area
the same length of road frontage
items.reason: 兄弟が同じ面積と同じ間口を得たと述べられています

sentences: A conscientious clerk noticed that two invoices had the same number.

clues: He checked all four hundred documents by hand
items.reason: 報告を送る前に、四百件の書類を手作業で確かめたと述べられています

sentences: Too diffident to apply, he let the deadline for the fellowship pass.

clues: He had written the essay in June
never believed it was good enough
items.reason: 六月に文章を書いていたのに、十分だとは思えなかったと述べられています

sentences: The two departments grew openly antagonistic after the budget was split.

clues: held separate meetings on the same subject
items.reason: 資料の共有をやめ、同じ議題で別々に会議を開いたと述べられています

sentences: His brash comments at the reception embarrassed the entire delegation.

clues: He told the host country's minister
items.reason: 受け入れ国の大臣に、その国の鉄道は笑い物だと言ったと述べられています

sentences: Only two venomous snake species live on the island.

items.reason: どちらに咬まれても数時間内の治療が必要だと述べられています

sentences: A stocky man in a raincoat waited beside the ticket machine.

clues: He was short but very broad
his coat did not close at the front
items.reason: 背は低いが幅が広く、上着の前が閉まらなかったと述べられています

items.reason: 三月に作られ、翌春まで事務所も持たなかったと述べられています

sentences: Engineers judged the tunnel route feasible but extremely expensive.

items.reason: 既存の機械で岩を掘れ、新しい技術も要らないと述べられています

clues: pays the same as a junior clerk
items.reason: 六十人を率いる職なのに、新人事務員と同じ額だと述べられています

sentences: Only half the inscription is still legible after four centuries.

clues: The first two lines can be read easily
items.reason: 最初の二行は容易に読め、残りは磨り減っていると述べられています

clues: He made a small joke about the waiting-room clock
items.reason: 診察のたび、待合室の時計について軽い冗談を言ったと述べられています

he answered with a joke about the weather
items.reason: 修繕費を尋ねられたのに、天気の冗談で返したと述べられています

clues: Either decision would shape the town's income
items.reason: どちらを選んでも、町の収入を今後五十年にわたり左右すると述べられています

items.reason: 半数の部屋が十度未満のままで、配管も二本凍ったと述べられています

clues: He changed hotels every four nights
items.reason: 四晩ごとに宿を替え、領収書も残さなかったと述べられています

items.reason: 旗と歌は自前でも、公務員の給与は別の国が払っていたと述べられています

items.reason: 手すりを握るのをやめ、水を一杯求めたと述べられています

clues: served every meal before the evening bell
items.reason: 誤りは幾つもあったが、夕の鐘までに全ての食事を出し終えたと述べられています

items.reason: 他の三地区の運転手も同調して仕事を止めたと述べられています

sentences: Her former supervisor vouched for the accuracy of every figure.
